description: Get a profile of one ransomware group: aliases, when RansomLook first observed it, and a sample of its newest claims. Use it to understand who a group is; use recent_claims for a longer list of its latest claims. Unknown groups return an error and are not charged. Every claim is an unverified claim from a criminal leak site, not a confirmed breach. Read-only. Costs $0.02 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure returns an error and is not charged.

group.description: Ransomware group name or alias, e.g. akira

name: group_profile
